day.reading: Chalub shows the transient, and 1/(2N) is imported from Wright-Fisher, not derived

critic.reading: Chalub derives P(fix) = x0 under the neutral constraints; Wright-Fisher sets x0 = 1/(2N) as the starting frequency

notes: Both Day versions say the series converges to u(p) = p only as t -> inf, which the series confirms (limit x0). Day's own post states the outcome (fixation equals the starting frequency) and Athos para 4 calls 1/(2N) the standard result. The 'dominant eigenvalue' gives the long-time decay exp(-t/2Ne); exp(-pi^2 Ne/T) is the short-time form of the whole series (M-204); the dominant term alone cannot give it (at T = Ne its one-term truncation is negative). A flag on Q286's wording, not on the closed form.
